passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and leaders of the priests, and go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. Proclaim there the words I speak to you, saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and residents of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on this place that the ears of all who hear of it will ring, because they have abandoned Me and made this a foreign place. They have burned incense in this place to other gods that neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have ever known. They have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a command.
The LORD told Jeremiah to go and buy a clay jar from a potter.
The LORD told Jeremiah to take some elders of the people with him.
The LORD told Jeremiah to take some elders of the priests with him.
The LORD told Jeremiah to go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom.
The Valley of Ben-hinnom is near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate.
The LORD told Jeremiah to proclaim His words there.
The LORD told Jeremiah to say these words to the people.
The LORD told Jeremiah to address the kings of Judah.
The LORD told Jeremiah to address the residents of Jerusalem.
The LORD is the LORD of Hosts.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said He will bring disaster on this place.
The disaster will be so great that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
Their ears will ring when they hear about it.
The LORD said the people have abandoned Him.
The people have made this place foreign to the LORD.
The people have burned incense in this place to other gods.
These other gods are unknown to the people, their fathers, and the kings of Judah.
The people have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הָל֛וֹךְ וְקָנִ֥יתָ בַקְבֻּ֖ק יוֹצֵ֣ר חָ֑רֶשׂ וּמִזִּקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וּמִזִּקְנֵ֖י הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃ וְיָצָ֙אתָ֙ אֶל־ גֵּ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֕ר פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר הַחֲרָסוּת וְקָרָ֣אתָ שָּׁ֔ם אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא רָעָה֙ עַל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּל־ שֹׁמְעָ֖הּ תִּצַּ֥לְנָה אָזְנָֽיו׃ יַ֣עַן׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָבֻ֗נִי וַֽיְנַכְּר֞וּ אֶת־ הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וַיְקַטְּרוּ־ בוֹ֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יְדָע֛וּם הֵ֥מָּה וַאֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם וּמַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּמָֽלְא֛וּ אֶת־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה דַּ֥ם נְקִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: They have built high places to Baal on which to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I never commanded or mentioned, nor did it even enter My mind.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah built high places for Baal.
They made these places for worship.
They burned their own children in fire on these altars.
They offered their children as sacrifices to Baal.
I am the LORD, the God of Israel.
I never commanded them to do this.
I never spoke about such a thing.
This idea never entered My mind.
passages.original: וּבָנ֞וּ אֶת־ בָּמ֣וֹת הַבַּ֗עַל לִשְׂרֹ֧ף אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֛ם בָּאֵ֖שׁ עֹל֣וֹת לַבָּ֑עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ צִוִּ֙יתִי֙ וְלֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתִּי וְלֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל־ לִבִּֽי׃פ

passages.text: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD declares a warning.
The LORD says days are coming.
In those days, this place will change.
People now call this place Topheth.
People also call it the Valley of Ben-hinnom.
In the future, people will not use these names.
People will call it the Valley of Slaughter.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־ יִקָּרֵא֩ לַמָּק֨וֹם הַזֶּ֥ה ע֛וֹד הַתֹּ֖פֶת וְגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֑ם כִּ֖י אִם־ גֵּ֥יא הַהֲרֵגָֽה׃

passages.text: And in this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, by the hands of those who seek their lives, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Judah and Jerusalem.
God will act in this place.
God will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem here.
God will make the people of Judah and Jerusalem fall by the sword.
Their enemies will kill them.
Those who seek their lives will defeat them.
God will give their dead bodies as food.
Birds of the air will eat their bodies.
Beasts of the earth will eat their bodies.
passages.original: וּ֠בַקֹּתִי אֶת־ עֲצַ֨ת יְהוּדָ֤ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִפַּלְתִּ֤ים בַּחֶ֙רֶב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְיַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ נִבְלָתָם֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: I will make this city a desolation and an object of scorn. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff at all her wounds.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Jerusalem.
God says, "I will destroy this city."
I will make Jerusalem empty and ruined.
People will see the city.
Everyone who passes by will be shocked.
They will see the city's troubles.
They will mock the city because of its wounds.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּי֙ אֶת־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לְשַׁמָּ֖ה וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְיִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל־ כָּל־ מַכֹּתֶֽהָ׃

passages.text: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh in the siege and distress inflicted on them by their enemies who seek their lives.’
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
God says he will bring great suffering to them.
Their enemies will attack them.
Their enemies will surround the city.
The people will be trapped inside.
They will have no food.
They will become desperate.
They will eat the flesh of their sons.
They will eat the flesh of their daughters.
They will eat the flesh of their friends.
This will happen during the siege.
Their enemies will cause this distress.
Their enemies want to kill them.
God will allow this as punishment.
passages.original: וְהַֽאֲכַלְתִּ֞ים אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֵת֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִ֥ישׁ בְּשַׂר־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ יֹאכֵ֑לוּ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֧יקוּ לָהֶ֛ם אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Then you are to shatter the jar in the presence of the men who accompany you, and you are to proclaim to them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I will shatter this nation and this city, like one shatters a potter’s jar that can never again be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room to bury them.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah is a prophet sent by the LORD of Hosts.
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
Jeremiah must take a jar.
He must shatter the jar.
He must do this while the men who walk with him are watching.
Jeremiah must speak to these men.
He must say, “This is what the LORD of Hosts says.”
The LORD says, “I will shatter this people and this city.”
I will break them like someone breaks a potter’s jar.
No one can repair a broken potter’s jar.
The people will bury the dead in Topheth.
They will do this because there will be no more room to bury them elsewhere.
passages.original: וְשָׁבַרְתָּ֖ הַבַּקְבֻּ֑ק לְעֵינֵי֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַהֹלְכִ֖ים אוֹתָֽךְ׃ וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת־ הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ וְאֶת־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁבֹּר֙ אֶת־ כְּלִ֣י הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ יוּכַ֥ל לְהֵרָפֵ֖ה ע֑וֹד וּבְתֹ֣פֶת יִקְבְּר֔וּ מֵאֵ֥ין מָק֖וֹם לִקְבּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: This is what I will do to this place and to its residents, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD declares His intentions.
The LORD will act against this place.
The LORD will act against the people who live here.
The LORD will make this city like Topheth.
Topheth is a place of defilement and judgment.
passages.original: כֵּֽן־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֞ה לַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה וּלְיֽוֹשְׁבָ֑יו וְלָתֵ֛ת אֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את כְּתֹֽפֶת׃

passages.text: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like that place, Topheth—all the houses on whose rooftops they burned incense to all the host of heaven and poured out drink offerings to other gods.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke about Jerusalem and Judah.
Jerusalem is the main city of God's people.
Judah is the kingdom where Jerusalem is found.
The kings of Judah ruled from Jerusalem.
Topheth was a place of defilement and idolatry.
God said the houses in Jerusalem will become like Topheth.
The houses of the kings of Judah will also become like Topheth.
These houses will be defiled.
People burned incense on the rooftops of these houses.
They burned incense to all the host of heaven.
The host of heaven means the sun, moon, and stars.
People poured out drink offerings in these houses.
They gave these offerings to other gods.
God will make these houses unclean because of this idolatry.
passages.original: וְהָי֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּבָתֵּי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּמְק֥וֹם הַתֹּ֖פֶת הַטְּמֵאִ֑ים לְכֹ֣ל הַבָּתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטְּר֜וּ עַל־ גַּגֹּֽתֵיהֶם֙ לְכֹל֙ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְהַסֵּ֥ךְ נְסָכִ֖ים לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then Jeremiah returned from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and proclaimed to all the people, “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I am about to bring on this city and on all the villages around it every disaster I have pronounced against them, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to heed My words.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The LORD sent Jeremiah to Topheth to prophesy.
Jeremiah returned from Topheth.
He stood in the courtyard of the house of the LORD.
He spoke to all the people.
Jeremiah said, “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says.
The LORD will bring disaster on this city and on all its villages.
The LORD has already spoken these disasters against them.
The people have stiffened their necks.
They refuse to listen to the words of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵֽהַתֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר שְׁלָח֧וֹ יְהוָ֛ה שָׁ֖ם לְהִנָּבֵ֑א וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃ס כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִי אֶל־ הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־ כָּל־ עָרֶ֔יהָ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֤י הִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ עָרְפָּ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֶת־ דְּבָרָֽי׃
